headline: IRGC Fires Ballistic Missiles at U.S. Forces as Zelensky Meets Trump
subheadline: Five ballistic missiles were fired from Iran toward Jordan, requiring ten Patriot missiles for interception while US and Saudi forces strike Iraq.
lede: The IRGC launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran toward U.S. forces in the Middle East, including Jordan, which were intercepted by Patriot missiles. Concurrently, U.S. and Saudi forces conducted airstrikes in Iraq, targeting PMU headquarters and causing casualties. In a separate diplomatic front, Zelensky arrived in the US and met with Trump in the Oval Office to discuss Patriot interceptor production licenses. Meanwhile, Russian forces attacked a Liberian-flagged civilian vessel near Odesa port, causing smoke in the bridge area.

sections.title: Zelensky Meets Trump Amid Maritime Attacks
sections.body: Zelensky arrived in the US and held a meeting with Trump in the Oval Office to discuss Patriot interceptor production licenses and diplomatic activation. Iran ballistic missile threat against Ukraine was reported by monitoring channels but officially unconfirmed; Ukrainian air defense later announced cancellation of ballistic weapon threat. Russian forces attacked a Liberian-flagged civilian vessel approaching Odesa port, causing smoke in the bridge area; the ship was unloaded and without crew. The Southern Mining and Processing Plant in Kryvyi Rih suspended extraction due to systematic Russian missile strikes on merchant ships carrying metallurgical products.

sections.title: IRGC Ballistic Missile Attacks and IDF Strikes
sections.body: The IRGC launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran toward U.S. forces in the Middle East, with five ballistic missiles fired toward Jordan and ten Patriot missiles used for interception. U.S. and Saudi forces conducted airstrikes in Iraq, targeting PMU headquarters and causing casualties. The IRGC attacked three tankers attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz. The IDF conducted an airstrike in Khan Younis, killing Muhammad Khalil Muhammad Aslam, a platoon commander in Islamic Jihad's elite forces, and targeted the Al-Mutakiin mosque near Al-Rimoun Stadium in central Gaza City.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous high-level diplomatic engagement and Iranian ballistic missile threat cancellation indicate a volatile strategic environment where political signaling and military deterrence are tightly coupled. Russian attacks on civilian shipping near Odesa demonstrate continued escalation in Black Sea maritime warfare, directly impacting Ukraine's export economy as evidenced by the Southern Mining plant suspension. The Iran threat trajectory analysis reveals a plausible launch corridor through Russian-controlled Caspian airspace, implying potential Russian-Iranian coordination that would significantly alter threat calculus.
